body:
Records the owner-confirmed verbal PDPA/legal review of 25 November 2026 in six agent-platform documents while preserving separate written approval, naming the server and date, before enabling the connector on a server with real patient data. The kpjaya.com connector remains explicitly OFF; the chatbox remains owner-controlled. This documentation update does not activate a service, change permissions or modify application code, environment configuration or BASELINE.

Normal refresh contains main eec5d5444bd14b0358e0383c1ea5d427e4d33f11 at candidate 6482bd9f19eb58e76a9d75b1252950eb2e199f28. All six scoped file blobs are identical to the original reviewed head e5f28db517091ca97176c0f7fc36a33b624d2fc7; merge was conflict-free and git diff --check passed. Independent refresh review and exact-head CI remain the release gates. No application tests were rerun solely for unchanged documentation.
